name: Pheonix's Tear
source:
William leads a quiet life as a convenience store employee until an extraordinary event changes everything. When his ghost roommate is mysteriously revived, William finds himself in the middle of a dangerous plot.

[From [url=https://yellow-chocobo.itch.io/pheonixs-tear]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
威廉作为一名便利店员工过着平静的生活，直到一场非凡的事件改变了一切。当他的幽灵室友神秘复活时，威廉发现自己陷入了一场危险的阴谋之中。

[来自[url=https://yellow-chocobo.itch.io/pheonixs-tear]itch.io[/url]]
